scope.title: Bakery custom orders and deposits
scope.domain: Investigate problems in small bakeries' custom orders and deposits. Explore deposit disputes, late changes, allergen and specification mix-ups, no-shows and pricing quotes. Look for owner accounts of actual disputes or losses, existing workarounds and process improvements.
scope.audience: Bakery owners and staff in shops with 1-3 people handling custom orders and deposits.
scope.observations: Bakery order and policy pages explain shop rules, but do not establish the problems owners actually experience. Find owner accounts and leave open whether the goal is a product for many bakeries or a process fix for one shop.
scope.riskEvaluationCriteria: Observed disputes or losses are required. A solution should fit a 1-3 person shop, have low setup cost, and be testable in a two-week pilot that counts disputes.
